title: Short Fart
blurb: Three tenths of a second, start to finish. This is the smallest unit of fart currently in circulation: one dry, airy pip with a sharp attack and no tail whatsoever. Brevity is the whole design. Because it ends before anyone can react, it works as pure punctuation — a comma where the loud versions are exclamation marks. Editors slip it between cuts or fire it twice for a double take, and on a Discord soundboard it is the polite option, insofar as that word applies to anything here. Blink and the joke has already happened without you.
